items.summary: Raytheon, an RTX (NYSE:RTX) company, has delivered and installed the first SPY-6(V)4 radar array at Wallops Island. The radar is part of the U.S. Navy's Flight IIA Destroyer modernization and backfit program. Extensive testing of the SPY-6(V)4 system is expected to follow this initial installation.
